config.fit: Freeze H259 input PCA/feature means/std. Natural loss normalized by training residual energy; supervised-head full-edit response loss normalized by training response energy. Equal sample weighting within each set, response coefficient beta0/1/10. Closed-form ridge, lambda=alpha*mean diagonal of combined feature normal matrix, intercept unpenalized. Response design rows have intercept0. Train first768, validate last256; choose alpha separately for each fixed beta by natural+beta*response normalized validation error. beta0 selection uses no response loss. No heldout-head responses in fit or selection. No refit. All beta outcomes retained, beta1 is primary, beta10 secondary.

gates.heldout_transfer: Quadratic beta1 improves missing-response fidelity over beta0 by>=.10 on ACTUAL heldout heads at BOTH scales, paired document-bootstrap95 lower bound>0.
gates.supervised_learning: Quadratic beta1 improves fidelity over beta0 by>=.10 on ACTUAL supervised heads at BOTH scales, lower bound>0.
gates.behavioral_transfer: Quadratic beta1 improves conditional KL over beta0 by>=.10 on ACTUAL heldout heads at BOTH scales, lower bound>0.

config.scope: Same128 H259 test documents reused. Head holdout means excluded from response targets/selection only; natural states contain all heads and PCA sees their ordinary context. H260 common-native-baseline mediation, float64 KL. No predictor input head ID, no test-native-error access. Core readout budgets unchanged; energy plus response objective differs from H259 state sensitivity.
